identity.silhouette: slender upright caster with asymmetrical mantle and floating octarine focus near the left shoulder
identity.face: adult woman, angular oval face, high cheekbones, focused violet-gray eyes, calm controlled expression
identity.hair: long dark indigo hair gathered behind the head with two loose front strands
signatureMarks: thin luminous octarine sigil crossing the right temple
faceted crystal focus hovering near the left shoulder
identity.wardrobe: layered midnight-blue arcane coat, fitted leather underlayer, silver-violet filigree, restrained crystalline accents

framing.safeArea: face and signature focus readable at 256x256

lighting.key: soft cool key from upper left
lighting.rim: subtle octarine rim on hair and mantle

states.neutral: composed, observant, closed mouth, restrained magical energy
states.speaking: measured explanation, slight mouth movement, attentive eyes
states.alert: eyes widened slightly, focus crystal activated, posture tightened
states.combat: intense gaze, active spell geometry, controlled power rather than rage
states.victory: small confident smile, relaxed shoulders, stable luminous sigil
states.defeat: fatigued and pained but dignified, dimmed focus crystal, no caricature

consistencyRules: same facial structure and apparent age in every state
same hair arrangement and front strands
same temple sigil shape and placement
same collar, mantle and crystal focus design
emotion changes must not redesign the character
